summary: I developed AgriShift, a data-driven decision tool that uses NASA Earth observation data to help farmers adapt to shifting climate zones. As rising temperatures and erratic rainfall disrupt traditional farming calendars, existing crop choices increasingly fail. AgriShift addresses this challenge by combining NASA datasets—including MODIS land surface temperatures, SMAP soil moisture, and GPM rainfall records—into simple, field-level recommendations. By entering their farm coordinates, growers receive localized forecasts for optimal planting windows, resilient crop alternatives, and precision irrigation schedules.
